Definition: to ponder, i.e. (by implication) converse (with oneself, and hence, aloud) or (transitively) utter
BiblicalUsage: 1) to put forth, mediate, muse, commune, speak, complain, ponder, sing; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to complain; 1a2) to muse, meditate upon, study, ponder; 1a3) to talk, sing, speak; 1b) (Polel) to meditate, consider, put forth thoughts
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
